note: Fresh family items for /this-week/ (QUEUE G01). Each item was read on its official page on observed_on; see docs/research/this-week-items-2026-10-28.md. Items whose expires_on is before today's America/New_York date are never rendered. Never carry a past year's dates forward; re-observe instead.

items.title: National Christmas Tree Lighting: free ticket lottery closes November 4
items.when: Lottery open from October 28 at 10 a.m. ET until Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 3 p.m. ET. Winners are notified Thursday, November 12, 2026. The ceremony is December 3, 2026 on the Ellipse.
items.cost: Free to enter and free tickets.
items.booking: Enter online on the Recreation.gov ticket page for the ceremony. Each winner may receive up to five tickets; entering does not guarantee tickets.
items.family: Up to five tickets per winner covers many families. The release gives no start time and no age rules for children.

items.title: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party: 25 nights at Magic Kingdom
items.when: Select nights November 8 to December 22, 2026: November 8, 9, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19, 20, 24, 25, 27 and 29; December 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 22. The party runs 7 p.m. to midnight; ticket holders may enter Magic Kingdom from 4 p.m.
items.cost: USD 189 to USD 229 per ticket plus tax, by date. Children ages 3 to 9 pay USD 10 less per ticket.
items.booking: Separate event ticket. Disney says tickets are limited and may not be available on the day of the event or earlier.
items.family: A late night for young children: the party ends at midnight. Check remaining nights on Disney's ticket page.

items.title: Holidays at Universal Orlando: included in theme park admission
items.when: November 14 to January 3 at Universal Studios Florida, Universal Islands of Adventure and Universal Epic Universe. Universal gives the dates without a year; we read them as November 14, 2026 to January 3, 2027.
items.cost: Included in theme park admission, per Universal’s events guide; it names no separate holiday ticket. Check the current day-ticket price with Universal.
items.booking: No separate event ticket. The holiday entry in Universal’s events guide lists no extras or prices, so any paid add-ons are not covered here.
items.family: It comes with a day ticket rather than a separate evening party ticket. Show times were not published on the guide; check the park schedule before planning around nap or bed times.
items.source_label: Universal Orlando events guide (Discover Universal, revised September 23, 2026)

items.title: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland: every visitor needs a booked entry slot
items.when: Every day from Thursday, November 19, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, except Christmas Day. Most days 10 a.m. to 10 p.m., some days open at 11 a.m., noon or 2 p.m.; last entry 9:30 p.m.
items.cost: Off-Peak entry slots are free but must still be booked. Standard and Peak slots are paid; check the current price on the official ticket site.
items.booking: Pre-book a date and an hourly arrival slot for everyone, including children ("whether you're 2 or 92"). Advance prices apply until 23:59 the day before.
items.family: The final day, January 3, 2027, is billed as a Family Fun Day; details were not yet published.
items.source_label: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland tickets guide

items.title: ZooLights at Lincoln Park Zoo: four free Monday nights with a reservation
items.when: Friday, November 20, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, 4:30 to 9 p.m.; last entry 8 p.m. No ZooLights on Thanksgiving (November 26), Tuesdays December 1, 8 and 15, or December 24 and 25.
items.cost: Fixed-date tickets USD 7 to USD 12 per person bought in advance, by date; USD 20 bought on the day or for a flexible ticket. Free on Mondays November 23 and 30 and December 7 and 14 with a reservation.
items.booking: Everyone needs a ticket, including children and infants. Free Monday tickets are released one week ahead at 11 a.m. CT.
items.family: Because infants need a ticket too, count every child when booking a free Monday.

items.title: Bronx Zoo Holiday Lights: Children's Zoo Farmyard opens for the lights, new for 2026
items.when: Select dates from November 21, 2026 to January 3, 2027. Check the zoo's tickets page for available dates and times.
items.cost: Admission price not shown on the event page; see the tickets page. The Holiday Train is USD 4 (USD 3 for members).
items.booking: Tickets are required and must be reserved in advance.
items.family: New for 2026: the Children's Zoo Farmyard opens during Holiday Lights, and a 2-in-1 ticket lets you arrive at 1 p.m. to see animals before the lights.

items.title: Boston's holiday tree arrives from Nova Scotia on Boston Common
items.when: Tuesday, November 24, 2026, 11 a.m. to noon, Boston Common (139 Tremont Street). The tree arrives by police escort at about 11 a.m.
items.booking: The city's listing names no tickets or registration.
items.family: Listed as family friendly. A short daytime event that suits children too young for the evening lighting.

items.title: Ford Holiday River Parade and river lighting, the day after Thanksgiving
items.when: Friday, November 27, 2026, 6 p.m., starting at the Tobin Center. Live broadcast at 7:05 p.m. from the Arneson River Theatre.
items.cost: A free viewing area is available. Seat tickets are sold online; the event page does not show their price, and tickets are non-refundable.
items.booking: Free viewing is first come, first served on the east side of the River Walk between Pecan Street and Richmond Avenue; bring your own chair.
items.family: Theme: "Holiday Wishes Come True". Bring chairs and arrive early for the free area.
items.source_label: San Antonio River Walk event page

items.title: Copley Square tree lighting with Santa, Rudolph and crafts
items.when: Monday, November 30, 2026, 5 to 6 p.m., Copley Square (560 Boylston Street), with the grand reopening of the renovated square.
items.booking: The city's listing names no tickets or registration.
items.family: Arts and crafts, Santa and Rudolph, and the Boston Children's Chorus. Afterward, cookies and photos with Santa at the Fairmont Copley Plaza at 6 p.m.

items.title: Boston Common Tree Lighting, then the Commonwealth Avenue Mall lights
items.when: Thursday, December 3, 2026, 6 to 8 p.m., Boston Common by the Visitor Information Center (139 Tremont Street). The Commonwealth Avenue Mall lights are scheduled to go on at about 8:15 p.m.
items.booking: The city's listing names no tickets or registration.
items.family: Listed as family friendly. The page does not describe children's activities.

items.title: Balboa Park December Nights: the city's free holiday festival
items.when: Friday, December 4, 2026, 4 to 10 p.m., and Saturday, December 5, 2026, noon to 10 p.m., Balboa Park.
items.booking: No ticket. The city warns of a fake online account asking for payment; it never asks for payment by Zelle or other person-to-person apps.
items.family: The Saturday noon start is the easier day with young children.
items.source_label: City of San Diego December Nights page

items.title: Smithsonian ZooLights: USD 10 tickets, free for kids 2 and under
items.when: Select evenings from November 20, 2026 to January 3, 2027: Nov 20-22, Nov 27-29, Dec 4-6, Dec 11-13, Dec 18-23, Dec 26-30 and Jan 2-3 (December 16 is adults-only). Monday to Saturday 5-9 p.m. (last entry 8:30 p.m.), Sunday 5-8 p.m. (last entry 7:30 p.m.), rain or shine.
items.cost: USD 10 per person; everyone age 3 and older needs a ticket and children 2 and younger are free. Event parking is USD 30 per vehicle in advance or USD 40 on the day, subject to availability.
items.booking: Tickets can be bought online in advance, and the zoo encourages buying early because capacity is limited. December 8 and 9 are Member Nights, with free entry tickets reserved in advance by zoo members.
items.family: Indoor animal exhibits are closed on ZooLights nights, and the zoo closes to everyone at 4 p.m. and reopens at 5 p.m. for ticket holders. Woodley Park-Zoo and Cleveland Park Metro stations are within walking distance.
items.source_label: Smithsonian National Zoo ZooLights news release (October 8, 2026)

items.title: Hogwarts in the Snow, Warner Bros. Studio Tour: new festive Foley session
items.when: November 14, 2026 to January 17, 2027, at the Warner Bros. Studio Tour London.
items.cost: Ticket prices are not shown on the event page; all Hogwarts in the Snow extras are included in the Studio Tour ticket price.
items.booking: Tickets must be booked in advance.
items.family: Original Harry Potter film sets are dressed for the season, and new for 2026 a Backlot Stage session shows how festive sound effects were made with Foley. Check child ticket rules and transport on the Studio Tour site before booking.
items.source_label: Warner Bros. Studio Tour London Hogwarts in the Snow page

items.title: EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays
items.when: November 27 to December 30, 2026 at EPCOT, per Disney's festival page. Disney's holidays page says the Candlelight Processional is performed at America Gardens Theatre during the festival; no show times are given yet.
items.cost: Not stated on Disney's festival pages: they give no prices and do not say what park admission covers. Check Disney's EPCOT ticket and festival pages before you go.
items.booking: Disney's festival pages mention no event ticket or reservation; the festival page says “Check back soon for more information!”
items.family: Disney's “Fun for All Ages” section lists Santa Claus photo visits, Goofy as Santa and Olaf's Holiday Tradition Expedition Scavenger Hunt; no age guidance is given.

items.title: Holiday Train Show at the New York Botanical Garden: two sensory-friendly mornings
items.when: November 14, 2026 to January 10, 2027 in the Enid A. Haupt Conservatory, with more trains in an outdoor display, per NYBG's event page. On select evenings (Nov 27–29; Dec 5, 11, 12, 18–20, 26–30; Jan 2) the Conservatory stays open until 8 p.m., last entry 7:15 p.m.
items.cost: Prices not shown on the event page; the page says the show is included in the All-Garden Pass. Check NYBG's tickets page for current prices.
items.booking: The event page links to NYBG's tickets page; it does not say whether advance or timed tickets are required for non-members.
items.family: Sensory-friendly mornings on Saturday, November 21, 2026 and Saturday, January 9, 2027, 9 to 11 a.m., with a ticket (the page says the All-Garden Pass is included with it): trains and waterfalls stay on, videos and music are off, with a quiet space and an alternate exit. No age guidance or stroller rules are given.
items.source_label: New York Botanical Garden event page

items.title: Gaylord Palms ice! near Orlando: The Polar Express carved in ice at 9°F, free parkas
items.when: November 13, 2026 to January 3, 2027, indoors at the Gaylord Palms resort in Kissimmee, Orlando area.
items.cost: Parking $38 a day self-park, $55 valet, plus tax. Regular ticket prices are not published: check your date and any child prices on GaylordPalmsTickets.com.
items.booking: Tickets must be bought in advance at GaylordPalmsTickets.com, for a set date and entry time; entry is not guaranteed if you arrive more than five minutes late. Hours vary by day. You do not need to stay at the hotel.
items.family: Everyone gets a free hooded, calf-length parka; inside it is 9°F. Extras cost more: Snow Flow Mountain (42-inch height minimum), Santa photos, gingerbread decorating and the holiday show are separate tickets.
items.source_label: Christmas at Gaylord Palms official site (home page and FAQ)

items.title: Gaylord National ice! near DC: the Grinch carved in ice at 9°F, free parkas
items.when: November 14, 2026 to January 3, 2027, indoors at the Gaylord National resort, National Harbor, Maryland, just south of DC.
items.cost: Parking $50 a day self-park, $75 valet; less for event day visitors. Regular ticket prices are not published: check your date and any child prices on ChristmasatGaylordNational.com.
items.booking: Tickets must be bought in advance at ChristmasatGaylordNational.com, for a set date and entry time; entry is not guaranteed if you arrive more than five minutes late. Hours vary by day. You do not need to stay at the hotel.
items.family: Everyone gets a free hooded parka, in sizes from infant up; inside it is 9°F. Small strollers are allowed if they do not block traffic; double or oversized strollers and wagons are not. Ice tubing, Santa photos and gingerbread decorating cost extra; the Coca-Cola Christmas Caravan, November 15 to 18 only, is free.
items.source_label: Christmas at Gaylord National official site (home page and FAQ)
